# Mokobara College Edit: the best laptop backpack for college (student concept)

> A student concept page for a Schbang x Atlas SkillTech brief. Not affiliated with Mokobara or 7Padel. All product facts and prices are from mokobara.com (checked 21 November 2026); padel facilities are from 7padel.in.

## Short answer
For most college students, the Mokobara Overnighter Backpack is the pick: it fits a 16-inch MacBook (15.6-inch for other laptops), expands from 19L to 23L, and its front pocket detaches into a sling bag. For lectures only, the Mokobara Backpack 16L fits a 15-inch laptop.

## What should I carry to my first padel game?
For your first padel game, carry court shoes, a water bottle, a towel and a change of clothes. No racket yet? 7Padel by MS Dhoni rents rackets and balls and has changing rooms. Coming straight from class? The Mokobara Overnighter Backpack fits a 16-inch MacBook and expands from 19L to 23L to hold your kit.

## Backpacks compared
- Overnighter Backpack: 16" MacBook / 15.6" laptop, 19L to 23L, detachable sling, USB port. https://mokobara.com/products/the-overnighter-backpack
- Backpack Pro 21L: 15.6" laptop or 16" MacBook Pro, key and card holder, water-resistant nylon. https://mokobara.com/products/the-backpack-pro-bags-online
- Backpack 16L: 15" laptop, zip-out water bottle pocket, water-resistant nylon. https://mokobara.com/products/the-backpack-bags-online
- Kaleido Backpack: 15.6" laptop, microsuede lining, mesh bottle pocket. https://mokobara.com/products/the-kaleido-backpack

## Buying confidence
- 30-day trial with a full refund on mokobara.com
- 12-month limited warranty on bags bought from mokobara.com

## 7Padel by MS Dhoni facilities (from 7padel.in)
Air-conditioned indoor arenas, racket and ball rental, shower and changing rooms, night lighting. Book at https://7padel.in
